title: Activation-addition behavior bank over a shared Mirror basis
hypothesis: For an aligned bank of 32 synthetic activation-addition functions, a rank-8 basis learned from 24 behaviors plus explicit per-behavior codes will preserve held-out probe outputs at relative RMSE <=0.05 while using <=0.65x the actual NPZ bytes of an explicit steering-vector bank in both development worlds.
physical_object: One frozen identity hidden-state map, one fixed behavior-probe matrix, and a bank of 32 additive hidden-state steering vectors.
mirror_coordinate: Per-behavior coefficient vector m_b over a learned shared activation-addition basis; rank sweep {2,4,8,16} is fixed.
logical_multiplicity: 32 behavior views, with behavior IDs 24-31 excluded from basis fitting and represented from 64 support activation contrasts.
controls: explicit Activation Addition vector per behavior from the same support contrasts
native PCA/SVD basis plus per-behavior coefficients (same algebra as Mirror)

task.type: synthetic activation-steering bank with frozen linear behavior probes
task.construction: s_b=U_8 c_b + rho*p_b where U_8 is shared orthonormal and p_b is seeded independent private activation variation; contrast targets are h+s_b versus h.
task.primary_metric: relative held-out behavior-probe output RMSE normalized by target probe-shift RMS
secondary_metrics: basis/code fit and inference wall time
causal output change when code is zeroed

development.selection: Report every frozen rank and rho; no post-run rank selection.
development.hyperparameter_changes_after_run: Prohibited without numbered amendment; code frozen before dev access.

fresh.opening_rule: Only open if at least one fixed rank passes quality and actual-byte gates and the candidate has a distinct useful margin over native PCA coefficient storage.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: frozen behavior-probe matrix in every method payload
explicit behavior steering vectors or shared basis
storage.shared_frozen_hidden_map: parameter-free identity; common and excluded from incremental payload

compute.proxy: explicit vector addition D operations; shared decode D*rank plus D addition; common probe matrix multiply excluded

gates.PROMISING: At rho=0 and rank 8 in both worlds, heldout relative output RMSE <=0.05 and actual payload <=0.65x explicit-vector payload; every heldout code causally changes outputs and behavior-score coverage remains 32/32. Native PCA attribution must be reported separately.
gates.FAIL: Full vector upper is valid but fixed gates fail or ordinary native PCA basis coefficients exactly explain the result without Mirror-specific advantage.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Explicit activation addition or serialized output replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic hidden-state steering functions only; no language-model behavior, prompt, NLL or human preference evidence.
The heldout behavior codes are fit from 64 activation contrasts, matching the adaptation information available to the explicit-vector control.
Off-target score diagnostics use a fixed random probe bank, not natural prompts or semantic safety tests.
No combinations beyond the 32 directly evaluated behavior IDs count as multiplicity; fresh worlds remain sealed unless gates and native attribution justify them.
